Review defect. AC-R2-8 (npm run build exit 0, transcript retained) was OMITTED from the first version of this ledger, so an APPROVED WITH NOTES was issued without the artifact orchestrator-role.md approval item 6 makes mandatory. Compounding it, the reviewer wrote ".next/BUILD_ID = 18:45:50" — that is the file mtime; the content is a random id. The freshness argument survives (BUILD_ID is written on successful completion, and its mtime post-dates every source edit and the final gate run) but it is not a transcript and it is not an exit code. Required correction: retain the build transcript, and re-run the build if the transcript was not captured. UPDATE 2026-08-16: the transcript now exists and the reviewer independently decoded EXIT=0 from it, so the build claim itself is settled. The row stays UNVERIFIED for one remaining reason, not a bookkeeping one: the file is UTF-16LE with a BOM and npm run check:mojibake FAILS on it right now, so committing it lands a red standing gate. Remediation is one re-run written as UTF-8 without BOM — on Windows PowerShell 5.1, Set-Content -Encoding utf8 writes a BOM and will NOT satisfy the gate; use [IO.File]::WriteAllText with (New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding $false), and set [Console]::OutputEncoding to UTF-8 first so the box-drawing and check glyphs are not mangled at capture time. RESOLVED 2026-08-16: build-final.txt now exists as UTF-8 without BOM, carries EXIT=0, and check:mojibake is green (0 artifacts / 2825 files).
